extension.summary: TeleNova add-ons and build updates (NovaTV + TeleScope AI)
TeleNova - Movies, Series, Live TV and Radio with Telegram links
TeleNova - סרטים, סדרות, ערוצים ורדיו עם קישורי טלגרם
TeleNova - фильмы, сериалы, ТВ и радио со ссылками Telegram
extension.description: Unified hub: TMDb catalogue, every title opens its list of tested Telegram links (TeleScope AI engine) next to the other sources, merged IPTV with auto numbering, radio, watch history, favourites, accounts and AI Hebrew subtitles.

extension.summary: Stream movies and series directly from your Telegram chats, with AI-verified sources
צפייה ישירה בסרטים וסדרות מתוך הטלגרם שלך, עם אימות מקורות בבינה מלאכותית
Фильмы и сериалы прямо из ваших чатов Telegram с проверкой источников ИИ
extension.description: TeleScope AI searches the Telegram channels and groups you have joined for the exact movie or episode you picked from the TMDB catalog, verifies every link (availability, file type, speed, episode accuracy) and streams it through a local high-speed range proxy with parallel read-ahead. Optional Google Gemini integration expands title aliases (Hebrew / Russian / English) and double-checks ambiguous matches.

TeleScope AI מחפשת בערוצים ובקבוצות הטלגרם שהצטרפת אליהם את הסרט או הפרק המדויק שבחרת מקטלוג TMDB, בודקת כל קישור (זמינות, סוג קובץ, מהירות, דיוק פרק) ומזרימה אותו דרך פרוקסי מקומי מהיר עם טעינה מקבילית מראש. שילוב Gemini אופציונלי מרחיב שמות חלופיים (עברית / רוסית / אנגלית) ומאמת התאמות לא חד-משמעיות.

TeleScope AI ищет в ваших каналах и группах Telegram именно тот фильм или серию, которые вы выбрали в каталоге TMDB, проверяет каждую ссылку (доступность, тип файла, скорость, точность серии) и воспроизводит её через локальный прокси с параллельной предзагрузкой. Gemini расширяет варианты названий и перепроверяет спорные совпадения.
extension.disclaimer: For personal use. Content availability depends on the Telegram chats you have joined.
extension.news: 3.3.4 - Real-Debrid: cached torrents (by IMDb id) and your RD cloud as sources, lighter checks (no download test, a failing link hands over to the next source when played), device-code login; results listed Telegram first, then Real-Debrid, then everything else. export / import of the whole configuration including the Telegram login (optionally password-protected .tncfg file). iPhone / iPad / Mac: Telegram decryption through the system library (CommonCrypto) instead of 0.1 MB/s pure Python; Apple's unsafe system libcrypto is never loaded (it aborts Kodi on macOS). Bots: files of bot chats are searched and browsed, bots that send files only on request are asked for the title automatically (buttons pressed, file-store links followed, "join first" demands shown), new "My bots" screen. Discovery finds bots too, ranks results, shows Telegram's similar channels and opens a public channel without joining. Every listed link is tested (dead links replaced by a mirror or removed), the real length, picture size and Hebrew tracks are read from the file itself. New result rows. 3.3.2 - Fast decryption on Android as well: the engine now carries its own AES library for Android (ARM 64 / 32-bit, x86), so Telegram videos no longer stall on devices where it reported 0.1 MB/s. 3.3.1 - Smoother playback: two connections of the player no longer cancel each other's read-ahead, a Telegram flood limit slows all requests down together instead of freezing the picture again and again, every stall is written to the log with its reason. 3.3.0 - Own native AES library on Windows (hundreds of MB/s instead of 0.2): Telegram streams play without buffering; no log errors about the removed POV add-on. 3.1.0 - Part of TeleNova. Much faster search: one request per query, a Telegram rate limit no longer freezes the search, 12 s limit, stragglers not waited for, AI and channel list never hold it up. Close matches are listed (marked ?) when nothing passes the strict rules. 3.0.1 - Link test reads 128 KB instead of 1 MB and never hides real matches when a slow box cannot finish it; faster AES on PyCryptodome; the "nothing found" box says why. 3.0.0 - Fixed first-run setup (pyaes is installed from its source archive; downloads are retried); login retries the setup by itself. 1.2.0 - Embedding API for NovaTV.
